source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once per battle, the Iconward can respond when a Cult Ambush marker would disappear due to an enemy move, as long as at least one model with this ability from your army is on the battlefield. Instead place the marker within 12″ of such a model and more than 8″ from all enemy units. Remove it under the usual rule if there is nowhere legal to put it.

detail.trigger: enemy movement would remove Cult Ambush marker
detail.condition: at least one friendly model with ability on battlefield
